name: Obsidex
summary: A dark eight-page crypto exchange desk with live prices, candles, order book and trading
about: A night-mode trading dashboard for a crypto exchange or fintech app, with invented coins whose prices tick every second. The trade terminal has a live candlestick chart, an order book, a market trades feed and a buy and sell form that really updates your balances. Wallet, orders, history, watchlist alerts, staking and settings pages are all working.
how: Open a page from the icon rail: Markets, Trade, Wallet, Orders, History, Watch, Earn or Settings
Click any market row or ticker to open it in the trade terminal
Pick Market or Limit, enter an amount or tap 25% to 100%, then Buy or Sell; balances update
Click an order book row to copy its price; limit orders fill when the live price reaches them
Set price alerts on the watchlist and stake coins on Earn to watch rewards count up
Switch the portfolio range or candle timeframe, press Ctrl+K to jump, and reset demo data in Settings
